extracted.intended_audience: comic collectors, archivists, scanners, and site contributors/users of Digital Comic Museum
extracted.subtask_description: Creating, uploading, and downloading scanned Golden Age comic books for a public-domain digital archive, following site rules about copyright, scan quality, and folder organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public domain / copyright verification
rubrics_metrics.description: All files here have been researched by our staff and users to make sure they are copyright free and in the public domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uploads and hosted files must be verified as public-domain; the site emphasizes that files have been researched to confirm they are copyright free. Contributors should verify copyright status before uploading and be prepared for takedown if rights-holder information arises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not share books printed after December 1959
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE - due to DCM's rule of Not sharing books post Dec 1959 several titles are incomplete on DCM
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Site policy: do not upload or share comic books printed after Dec 1959 (or known non-public-domain material). This is an explicit cutoff used to judge what may be hosted; many collections are incomplete because of this rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country-specific public-domain caution
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not upload anything printed after 1959 or that contains known non-PD material in these countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors must consider jurisdictional/public-domain differences (UK/Australia/NZ, etc.) and avoid uploading material that is not PD in relevant countries. The site flags country-specific non-PD concerns for some folders (e.g., UK/Australian and NZ Comics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Placeholder / GM scan policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Placeholder scans: A home for orphaned or 'Grossly Mistreated' (GM) scans. These are best thought of as placeholders until hopefully a better scan can be uploaded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have a GM scan of a book ALREADY on the site please don't upload it. If you have a GM scan of something NOT on the site or that the site is incomplete on, please DO upload it to this folder. Owners of the physical book are encouraged to provide better scans to replace GM placeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encouragement to replace low-quality scans
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone that owns one of these books PLEASE consider scanning and sharing a better scan!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site explicitly asks owners to upload improved scans to replace small/watermarked/poor scans. Notes like '(ifc repaired) -upgrade' and 'upgrade' appear on items, indicating an expectation and process for scan improvements and re-uploads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize uploads into proper folders / sub-categories
rubrics_metrics.description: These will be integrated into their proper folders in the near future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scans and new uploads should be placed in appropriate collections/archives and sub-categories (publisher, series, giveaways, placeholders, etc.). The site maintains a hierarchical organization (archives, publishers, sub-categories) and expects uploads to be slotted into those structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register an account to download
rubrics_metrics.description: To start downloading just register an account and enjoy these great comic books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must register/log in to download files; the site does not charge per download but requires an account for access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical instruction for downloading
rubrics_metrics.description: CLICK ON THE DOWNLOAD LINKS TO GET TO THE REAL DOWNLOADS - IGNORE ANY '0 Bytes' MESSAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational note for users: some pages or items may show '0 Bytes' placeholders; users should click the download links to reach the actual file downloads rather than relying on displayed file-size indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with rights-holder notices / takedowns
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE - Warner Brothers (current owners of Fawcett copyrights) legal representation has informed us several Fawcett books on DCM were in fact not in the public domain and must come down.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site will remove material if rights-holders provide evidence. Contributors and users should monitor forum/legal notices for takedown actions (forum link provided) and expect certain uploads to be removed if a rights claim is validated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer researched metadata and provenance
rubrics_metrics.description: All files here have been researched by our staff and users to make sure they are copyright free and in the public domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond copyright status, the site values researched metadata (publisher, dates, variants noted such as 'diff ver', 'inc', 'c2c', 'paper', 'ifc repaired'). Good uploads should include clear provenance and descriptive notes to help cataloguing and future verification.
